fire: Whisk the eggs with the sugar, then fold in the flour gently.
Fry the onions until golden, then add the garlic and cumin.
Season the chicken well, then roast it for forty minutes.
Water the seedlings lightly, then cover the tray with a lid.
Simmer the stock for an hour, then strain it into a clean pot.
Knead the dough for ten minutes, then leave it to rise.
Dig a hole twice as wide as the root ball, then set the shrub into it.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, then sprinkle with parmesan.
quiet: She thanked the guests at the door, then drove home alone.

The company cut its prices, then lost money for two years.

The chef was born in Lyon and trained in a famous kitchen.

predictions: Fires inside imperative recipe or planting steps, most at ', then' before the next action; quiet on 'then' and similar links in narrative or non-procedural text.
